notes:
Evaluation narrative: Mariner Loom started on Hosted API to validate feature set (streaming, function-calls). POC metrics show acceptable latency but hosted per-token cost higher than their internal budget for projected 250M tokens/month. They are now engaged in procurement for Redwood Dedicated. Key negotiation topics: commit sizing (3 vs 6 reserved GPU-equivalents), burst allowance (1.5x–2x baseline without punitive overage), predictable overage pricing (flat per-token overage rather than percentage), and a 6- to 12-month ramp schedule with step-up pricing tied to usage tiers.

Specific asks from Mariner Loom (paraphrased from calls):
- "We need a predictable monthly cost that lets us model CAC payback; bursts for seasonal support spikes are ok but can't produce bill shock."
- "If we commit for 12 months we expect deeper discounts and guaranteed burst capacity for up to 2x sustained for short windows."
- "Must have VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS and audit logging; SOC2 and SSO are gating requirements for procurement."

POC results & metrics:
- Target workload for Dedicated: chat (multi-turn) + embeddings for search + reranking for support routing.
- Observed Hosted p95: 180-230ms (varies by model), target p95 on Dedicated <= 150ms for the common path.
- Throughput targets: steady-state 40 QPS, peak 120 QPS; internal target for Q3: 2x steady-state.
- Cost expectation: target blended unit cost no higher than $0.0009 per token equivalent at their 6T/month projection.

Commercial negotiation points logged:
- Commit tiers proposed: 3T/mo, 6T/mo, 12T/mo (token-equivalent) with step discounts.
- Burst policy requested: baseline + 50%-100% burst allowance with capped overage price for sustained exceedance beyond burst windows.
- Ramp schedule: month 1-3 baseline commit usage, months 4-6 step to 100% of committed run-rate, months 7-12 auto-renew/step-up option.
- Overage: client prefers an absolute per-token overage charge rather than % of committed price; they asked for a sample invoice run showing 2 burst events per month.

Open action items: SE to deliver Dedicated perf/runbook with estimated reserved GPU vCPU counts and expected latency improvements (due 2026-03-18). AE to send updated pricing sheet with 12-month commit options and explicit overage caps (due 2026-03-16). Security to provide SOC2 snapshot + KMS integration notes (link in drive).
